description: This file defines the ImapHandler class, a wrapper for PHP's IMAP extension functions. It manages IMAP mailbox operations and error logging, providing an abstraction layer for IMAP interactions in the SuiteCRM project.

classes.name: ImapHandler
classes.description: Wrapper class for PHP's IMAP extension functions, managing mailbox operations, error logging, and providing an API for IMAP interactions.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the ImapHandler with options for error and call logging, and sets the charset.

methods.name: setStream
methods.description: Sets the internal stream resource after validating it.

methods.name: getStream
methods.description: Retrieves the current stream resource, with optional validation.

methods.name: log
methods.description: Logs errors or warnings encountered during IMAP operations.

methods.name: logCall
methods.description: Logs the invocation of a method with its arguments.

methods.name: logReturn
methods.description: Logs the return value of a method call.

methods.name: getConnection
methods.description: Returns the current IMAP stream resource.

methods.name: getErrors
methods.description: Retrieves the list of IMAP errors.

methods.name: getLastError
methods.description: Gets the last IMAP error message.

methods.name: getMailboxes
methods.description: Fetches mailbox list based on reference and pattern.

methods.name: isAvailable
methods.description: Checks if IMAP extension functions are available.

methods.name: setTimeout
methods.description: Sets timeout options for IMAP operations.

methods.name: executeImapCmd
methods.description: Executes an IMAP command with charset handling and error recovery.

methods.name: getHeaderInfo
methods.description: Fetches headers information for a message.

methods.name: fetchHeader
methods.description: Fetches the header of a message.

methods.name: append
methods.description: Appends a message to a mailbox.

methods.name: getUid
methods.description: Retrieves UID for a message number.

methods.name: fetchBody
methods.description: Fetches the body of a message.

methods.name: getNumberOfMessages
methods.description: Returns count of messages in mailbox.

methods.name: isValidStream
methods.description: Checks if the provided stream is a valid resource.

methods.name: getMessageList
methods.description: Retrieves a list of messages with filtering, sorting, and pagination options.

methods.name: messageStructureHasAttachment
methods.description: Checks if message structure contains attachments.
